hero.paragraph: I-HydroLedger inikeza imiphakathi yezindlu imininingwane yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngesikhathi sangempela, ukukhokhiswa okusobala okwabiwe, kanye nezixwayiso zokuvuza kusenesikhathi — konke kudeshibhodi eyodwa.

features.paragraph: Valelisa ekuhlukanisweni kwezindleko zezinsiza ngenani elilodwa. I-HydroLedger ikhuthaza ukulingana ngokusebenzisa izilinganiso ezinembile kanye nokuzenzakalelayo okuhlakaniphile.

items.title: Ukukala Amanzi Ngesikhathi Sangempela
items.text: Kala ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuqondile, umzuzu nomzuzu, kuwo wonke amayunithi esikhundleni sokuthembela ezilinganisweni zakudala.

items.title: Ukukhokhiswa Komphakathi Okuzenzakalelayo
items.text: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-invoice okuqondile okwenzelwe abahlali okuhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwabo. Qeda izindleko zokukhokhiswa khona manjalo.

items.title: Izixwayiso Zokutholwa Kokuvuza Kusenesikhathi
items.text: Izixwayiso ezizenzakalelayo ezisheshayo zikhombisa amaphethini okugeleza angajwayelekile futhi zibamba umonakalo omkhulu wamanzi phakathi nemizuzu, hhayi izinyanga.

items.title: Ukwabiwa Kwezindleko Okufanele
items.text: Landelela ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo ezivamile futhi usabalalise izindleko ngokusalala ukuze wakhe ukwethembana nokonga emakhaya.

howItWorks.heading: Ukufakwa Okungenazinkinga, Ukusebenza Okuzenzakalelayo
howItWorks.paragraph: Qala ngokushesha. Uma amayunithi e-hardware exhumekile, inkundla iphetha izibalo eziyinkimbinkimbi, ukuthunyelwa kwama-invoice, nezixwayiso zokuvuza ngokwemvelo.

steps.title: Xhuma Amamitha Ahlakaniphile
steps.text: Ochwepheshe bethu abagunyaziwe bafaka amamitha okugeleza ahlakaniphile ngqo kumavalvu okuphakela amayunithi ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-15.

steps.title: Ukulandelela Ngesikhathi Sangempela
steps.text: Idatha igeleza ngokuqhubekayo iye endaweni ye-HydroLedger cloud, iloga izibalo eziqondile zokusetshenziswa futhi iqapha imisebenzi engajwayelekile.

steps.title: Zenzakalela Izikweletu
steps.text: Ekupheleni kwenyanga, injini ihlanganisa ukusatshalaliswa kwezindawo ezivamile kanye namavolumu alinganisiwe abe ama-invoice acacile, anemininingwane.

portalPreview.paragraph: Ukubeka izinto obala kwakha ukuvumelana komphakathi. Abahlali bajabulela amadeshibhodi alula anempendulo yesikhathi sangempela, izibikezelo zezindleko, nezixwayiso zokuvuza ezisheshayo.
portalPreview.tipText: Iphayiphi lakho lasekhishini likhombisa ukugeleza okuncane njalo ekuseni. Ukuhlola ama-aerator kungonga amagaloni afika kwangu-10 ngeviki.

audienceSplit.residentParagraph: Yeka ukukhokhela ukusetshenziswa ngokweqile komakhelwane bakho. Khokha ngokuqinile amagaloni owasebenzisayo, asekelwe idatha yedashibhodi yesikhathi sangempela.
residentBullets: Idatha yokukala ngenyanga enembile enezilinganiso zezindleko ezisobala.
Izaziso ze-SMS ne-mobile uma kutholakala ukuvuza okuncane ezintweni zasekhaya.
Uhlelo lokukhokha lwe-invoice olulula, oluqondile olunezirisidi ezizenzakalelayo.
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: Guqula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza kusuka enhlungwini yelahleko enkulu uye emapayipini angenazinkinga, anenzuzo ephezulu ngokukhokhiswa okuzenzakalelayo kwabahlali.
adminBullets: Ukwabiwa kwezinsiza okungenazandla okuxhunywe ngqo kumayunithi ngamanye.
Izixwayiso zokusebenza ezisheshayo zokuvimbela umonakalo omkhulu wamanzi.
Ukubika kwedeshibhodi okuningiliziwe ekukhokhisweni kwamamitha amakhulu vs. amagaloni asatshalaliswe.

pricing.heading: Izindleko Zokusebenza Zokubuyiselwa Kwezimali Eziphakeme
pricing.paragraph: Khetha uhlelo olulinganiselwe kwisilinganiso somphakathi wakho. I-HydroLedger imvamisa yenza imali yayo emuva ngenyanga yokuqala ngokunciphisa imfucuza yezindawo ezivamile.

tiers.name: Qala
tiers.desc: Ilungele izinhlangano ezincane zamathawuni ezidinga amakhono ayisisekelo okulinganisa.

tiers.name: Ochwepheshe
tiers.desc: Iphakethe lethu eliphambili lemiphakathi yezindlu ezifuna ukukhokhiswa kwabahlali okuzenzakalelayo ngokuphelele.

tiers.name: Ibhizinisi
tiers.desc: Emiphakathini emikhulu edinga amapayipi e-API enziwe ngokwezifiso nezilungiselelo zokukhokha.

quotes.text: I-HydroLedger ishintshe i-P&L yethu yokusebenza ngokuyisisekelo. Sithole ukuvuza okuthathu okukhulu okufihliwe emapayipini emishini okusongele ngaphezu kuka-₹11 lakh kwikota yethu yokuqala kuphela.

Ukwethenjwa kwabahlali kukhuphuke kakhulu. Ukukhokhisa abaqashi bethu ngokusekelwe ngokuqinile ekusebenziseni amanzi esikhundleni sezibalo ezijwayelekile zamamitha amakhulu kuxazulule izingxabano zethu ezibuhlungu kakhulu zabaqashi.

items.q: Ingabe amamitha amancane ahlakaniphile adinga ukuvalwa kwemishini?
items.a: Cha. Amayunithi ethu emitha amancane afakwa ngaphandle kokuhlasela ngqo phezu kwemigqa ekhona ezindaweni ezincane. Ukusetha kuqedwa ngokuhlanzekile ngemizuzu ngaphandle kokunqanyulwa kwezinsiza.

Idamu eliphakathi lezindawo ezivamile (isb. izindawo zamachibi, ukulungisa izivande) lisuswa ngokuhlanzekile emamithini amakhulu kuqala. Amaqembu ezakhiwo abeka lezo zindleko ngokusekelwe esakhiweni noma ngokulinganisa ngokusobala.

items.q: I-HydroLedger ithola kanjani ukuhamba kwamanzi okuvuza okuqhubekayo ngokushesha?
items.a: Amapayipi ethu ezaziso angemuva ahlola izimpawu zokudonsa okuqhubekayo. Uma ukugeleza kungathinti uziro emjikelezweni wemizuzu eyi-10, izixwayiso zithunyelwa khona manjalo ukuze kuncishiswe ubungozi bomonakalo.

items.q: Ingabe i-HydroLedger iphatha ukuphepha noma ubumfihlo babahlali?
items.a: Yebo. I-HydroLedger ivikela futhi igcine izikhombi ze-portal yezakhamuzi ngemuva kweziteshi ezibhalwe ngemfihlo. Idatha yokusebenza igcinwa iphephile ngokuqinile ukulandelela ukusetshenziswa.

cta.heading: Qala Ukuqapha Ukusetshenziswa Kwamanzi Akho Namuhla
cta.paragraph: Khuthaza izilinganiso zokulondoloza, yenza lula izindleko zokukhokha zabahlali, futhi uvikele ingqalasizinda yemizi eminingi eyigugu. Ake sibale isilinganiso sakho somphakathi se-ROI.

footer.tagline: Amapayipi okwabiwa kwezinsiza ahlakaniphile nezixazululo zokukala zamanzi ezindawo zokuhlala zesikhathi sangempela. Vikela izinhlelo, vumelanisa izikweletu, yonga amanzi.
